source_text: SIARAN MEDIA MALAYSIA PACU KEPIMPINAN SERANTAU PENGURUSAN BENCANA MELALUI RESILIENT ASIA 2026
target_text: PRESS RELEASE MALAYSIA DRIVES REGIONAL LEADERSHIP IN DISASTER MANAGEMENT THROUGH RESILIENT ASIA 2026

source_text: KUALA LUMPUR, 23 April 2026 – Timbalan Perdana Menteri, YAB Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid Hamidi hari ini merasmikan Resilient Asia 2026 Ekspo dan Forum di Pusat Dagangan Dunia Kuala Lumpur (WTCKL).
target_text: KUALA LUMPUR, 23 April 2026 – Deputy Prime Minister, YAB Dato’ Seri Dr. Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, today officiated the Resilient Asia 2026 Expo and Forum at the World Trade Centre Kuala Lumpur (WTCKL).

source_text: Bertemakan “Pendayagunaan AI Dalam Memacu Pengurusan Bencana Ke Arah Komuniti Berdaya Tahan”, program ini menghimpunkan pakar antarabangsa, agensi teknikal, agensi tindak balas, peneraju teknologi dan pemain industri dari rantau Asia dalam satu platform strategik yang memfokuskan kepada transformasi pengurusan bencana berasaskan teknologi.
target_text: Carrying the theme “Empowering AI to Advance Disaster Management Towards Resilient Communities,” the programme brings together international experts, technical agencies, response agencies, technology leaders, and industry players from across Asia on a strategic platform focused on transforming disaster management through technology.

source_text: Timbalan Perdana Menteri menekankan bahawa cabaran bencana masa kini yang semakin kompleks, didorong oleh perubahan iklim dan krisis kemanusiaan, menuntut kerjasama rentas sempadan yang lebih kukuh. Menurut beliau tiada negara mampu berdepan risiko ini secara bersendirian tanpa kolaborasi global yang berkesan.
target_text: The Deputy Prime Minister emphasised that today’s increasingly complex disaster challenges, driven by climate change and humanitarian crises, require stronger cross-border cooperation. He noted that no country can face these risks alone without effective global collaboration.

source_text: Sebagai penganjuran sulung pada skala antarabangsa, Resilient Asia 2026 memberi tumpuan kepada pemanfaatan teknologi kecerdasan buatan (AI) dalam mempertingkat keupayaan ramalan, mempercepat tindak balas kecemasan serta latihan kesiapsiagaan pasukan penyelamat.
target_text: As its inaugural edition at an international scale, Resilient Asia 2026 focuses on leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance predictive capabilities, accelerate emergency response, and strengthen preparedness training for rescue teams.

source_text: Penganjuran ini selari dengan aspirasi Malaysia untuk muncul sebagai hab pengurusan bencana serantau di Asia Tenggara, sejajar dengan Wawasan Komuniti ASEAN 2045, di samping mencerminkan pendekatan whole-of-government dan whole-of-society dalam memperkukuh daya tahan negara.
target_text: The event aligns with Malaysia’s aspiration to emerge as a regional disaster management hub in Southeast Asia, in line with the ASEAN Community Vision 2045, while reflecting a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach to strengthening national resilience.

source_text: Resilient Asia 2026 mendapat penyertaan lebih 100 pempamer daripada agensi kerajaan dan syarikat tempatan serta antarabangsa seperti China, Jerman, Kanada dan Amerika Syarikat di ruang pameran berkeluasan 4,917 meter persegi.
target_text: Resilient Asia 2026 features participation from more than 100 exhibitors representing government agencies and local as well as international companies from countries including China, Germany, Canada, and the United States, across an exhibition space spanning 4,917 square metres.

source_text: Penyertaan 25 delegasi luar negara untuk program ini adalah dalam kalangan negara-negara ASEAN, Australia, Korea Selatan, Jepun, Pakistan, Qatar, Rusia, United Kingdom, Switzerland serta wakil kedutaan di Malaysia turut memperkukuh jaringan kerjasama strategik dalam bidang bantuan kemanusiaan, inovasi teknologi dan keupayaan tindak balas bencana, dengan menggunakan teknologi realiti terimbuh berasaskan lokasi (Location-based Augmented Reality, LAR) yang dipersembahkan sepanjang Resilient Asia 2026 berlangsung.
target_text: The participation of 25 international delegations—including ASEAN member states, Australia, South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, Qatar, Russia, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, as well as representatives from foreign embassies in Malaysia—further strengthens strategic collaboration networks in humanitarian assistance, technological innovation, and disaster response capabilities. The programme also showcases location-based augmented reality (LAR) technology throughout the event.

source_text: Program ini dijangka menarik lebih 10,000 pengunjung sepanjang tiga (3) hari berlangsung bermula 24 hingga 26 April 2026. Pameran dibuka bermula 10.00 pagi sehingga 6.00 petang.
target_text: The programme is expected to attract more than 10,000 visitors over three days, from 24 to 26 April 2026. The exhibition will be open daily from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

source_text: Pelan Strategik Agensi Pengurusan Bencana Negara (NADMA) 2024-2028 merupakan panduan penting dalam memantapkan kepimpinan dan peranan NADMA selaku Agensi Peneraju Utama pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana (Disaster Risk Reduction, DRR).
target_text: The National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) Strategic Plan 2024–2028 serves as an important guide in strengthening NADMA’s leadership and role as the lead agency in disaster management and disaster risk reduction (DRR).

source_text: Malaysia terdedah kepada pelbagai risiko bencana seperti banjir, tanah ruhth, kebakaran hutan dan lain-lain lagi.
target_text: Malaysia is exposed to various disaster risks such as floods, landslides, forest fires, and others.

source_text: Adalah penting bagi kita untuk memastikan pewujudan dokumen panduan supaya semua pihak dapat merencana tindakan untuk memperkukuh kesiapsiagaan serta bertindak proaktif dalam mengurus risiko dari pelbagai aspek.
target_text: It is crucial to establish a guiding document so that all parties can plan actions to enhance preparedness and act proactively in managing risks from multiple dimensions.

source_text: Tanggungjawab pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana merupakan tanggungjawab semua lapisan masyarakat dan bukan hanya tanggungjawab pihak Kerajaan semata-mata.
target_text: Disaster risk management and reduction is the responsibility of all levels of society, not solely the Government.

source_text: NADMA berhasrat untuk memperkukuhkan pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana di semua peringkat, bermula dari peringkat akar umbi, sehinggalah di peringkat Pusat.
target_text: NADMA aspires to strengthen disaster risk management and reduction at every level, from the grassroots to the national level.

source_text: Berpandukan kepada enam (6) teras, NADMA akan memberi fokus kepada peningkatan kapasiti pelbagai pihak bagi mengurus sesuatu bencana secara terselaras berasaskan konsep “whole of nation approach”.
target_text: Guided by six (6) strategic pillars, NADMA will focus on building the capacity of multiple stakeholders to manage disasters in a coordinated manner based on the “whole-of-nation approach.”

source_text: Pelan Strategik ini turut dijajarkan bagi memperkukuhkan Dasar Nasional DRR dengan menekankan kepentingan pemantauan dan penilaian risiko serta pemulihan pasca-bencana yang holistik.
target_text: This Strategic Plan is also aligned to reinforce the National DRR Policy, highlighting the importance of risk monitoring and assessment and holistic post-disaster recovery.

source_text: Pelan ini menekankan penglibatan komuniti dalam proses perancangan dan pelaksanaan dasar bagi mengelak dan mengurangkan risiko berlakunya bencana semula jadi dan bukan semula jadi.
target_text: This plan emphasizes community involvement in policy planning and implementation to prevent and reduce the risks of both natural and non-natural disasters.

source_text: Strategi ini menyasarkan pengurangan jumlah mangsa yang terkesan, kehilangan nyawa, kemusnahan harta benda, tempat tinggal, pekerjaan, infrastruktur, ekonomi dan kesihatan.
target_text: This strategy aims to minimize the number of affected victims, loss of lives, destruction of property, homes, livelihoods, infrastructure, economy, and health.

source_text: Saya menyeru seluruh warga NADMA untuk komited melaksanakan Pelan Strategik ini secara efektif.
target_text: I call upon all NADMA personnel to be committed to executing this Strategic Plan effectively.

source_text: Kita semua mempunyai peranan penting dalam memastikan pencapaian Pelan Strategik ini adalah mengikut tempoh yang disasarkan dalam memenuhi visi dan misi NADMA.
target_text: We all play a vital role in ensuring that the objectives of this Strategic Plan are achieved within the targeted timeframe to fulfill NADMA’s vision and mission.

source_text: Semangat kerjasama dan komitmen dari semua pihak adalah kunci kejayaan kita dalam memastikan keselamatan dan kesejahteraan rakyat Malaysia.
target_text: The spirit of cooperation and commitment from all parties is the key to our success in ensuring the safety and well-being of the Malaysian people.

source_text: Punca kuasa utama adalah termaktub di dalam Arahan Majlis Keselamatan Negara (MKN) No. 20: Dasar dan Mekanisme Pengurusan Bencana Negara.
target_text: The primary source of authority is enshrined in the National Security Council (NSC) Directive No. 20: National Disaster Management Policy and Mechanism.

source_text: Arahan ini memperincikan keperluan penubuhan Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana, sebagaimana peruntukan di bawah Seksyen 12 dalam Akta Majlis Keselamatan Negara 2016 (Akta 776).
target_text: This directive details the requirements for the establishment of the Disaster Management Committee, as provided under Section 12 of the National Security Council Act 2016 (Act 776).

source_text: Arahan ini menggariskan mekanisme yang lebih menyeluruh meliputi peringkat sebelum, semasa dan selepas sesuatu kejadian bencana untuk dikendalikan secara bersepadu.
target_text: This directive outlines a comprehensive mechanism covering the pre-, during, and post-disaster phases to be managed in an integrated manner.

source_text: Mekanisme ini secara langsung dapat mengelakkan pembaziran, kekeliruan, konflik, percanggahan atau pertindihan peranan semasa menangani sesuatu kejadian bencana.
target_text: This mechanism directly prevents wastage, confusion, conflict, contradictions, or overlapping roles while handling a disaster event.

source_text: Mandat utama penubuhan Agensi Pengurusan Bencana Negara (NADMA) diperincikan dalam Keputusan Jemaah Menteri bertarikh 26 Ogos 2015.
target_text: The primary mandate for the establishment of the National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) is detailed in the Cabinet Decision dated 26 August 2015.

source_text: Keputusan ini memberi kuasa kepada NADMA sebagai agensi peneraju utama atau focal point untuk memastikan pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana (Disaster Risk Reduction, DRR) secara berterusan.
target_text: This decision empowers NADMA as the lead agency or focal point to ensure continuous disaster risk management and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR).

source_text: NADMA menjalankan kewajipan melalui beberapa inisiatif atau program pencegahan, peredaan dan kesiapsiagaan menghadapi bencana.
target_text: NADMA carries out its duties through various initiatives or programs for disaster prevention, mitigation, and preparedness.

source_text: Apabila NADMA mengambil alih peranan daripada Majlis Keselamatan Negara (MKN), keputusan Jemaah Menteri pada 1 September 2010 berhubung peneraju utama pengurusan bencana di peringkat ASEAN, Asia dan antarabangsa adalah terpakai.
target_text: When NADMA took over the lead role from the National Security Council (NSC), the Cabinet decision dated 1 September 2010 regarding the lead agency for disaster management at the ASEAN, Asian, and international levels remains applicable.

source_text: NADMA bertanggungjawab untuk menjalankan obligasi serta komitmen negara terhadap instrumen serantau dan antarabangsa berhubung pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana (DRR).
target_text: NADMA is responsible for fulfilling the nation's obligations and commitments to regional and international instruments regarding disaster risk management and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR).

source_text: Menjadi agensi peneraju utama (focal point) pengurusan Bencana dan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana di peringkat Nasional, Serantau dan Antarabangsa.
target_text: Serving as the lead agency (focal point) for disaster management and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) at the National, Regional, and International levels.

source_text: Mengeluarkan strategi, arahan, pelan tindakan, hala tuju dan apa-apa dokumen panduan atau rujukan berkaitan, dengan pengurusan Bencana dan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana di peringkat dasar.
target_text: Issuing strategies, directives, action plans, roadmaps, and any related guiding or reference documents for disaster management and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) at the policy level.

source_text: Memastikan pengamalan serta pelaksanaan dasar dan mekanisme pengurusan Bencana dan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana berjalan lancar.
target_text: Ensuring the practice and implementation of policies and mechanisms for disaster management and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) proceed smoothly.

source_text: Memberi khidmat nasihat mengenai pengendalian serta pengurusan Bencana dan Pengurangan Risiko Bencana mengikut kesesuaian.
target_text: Providing advisory services on the handling and management of disasters and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) as appropriate.

source_text: Menasihati Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Daerah (JBPD), Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Negeri (JPBN) dan Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Pusat (JPBP).
target_text: Advising the Chairpersons of the District Disaster Management Committee (JBPD), State Disaster Management Committee (JPBN), and Central Disaster Management Committee (JPBP).

source_text: Mengumpul, menganalisis dan menyebarkan maklumat Bencana melalui Pusat Kawalan Bencana Negara (National Disaster Command Centre, NDCC).
target_text: Collecting, analyzing, and disseminating disaster information through the National Disaster Command Centre (NDCC).

source_text: Mengurus dan mengaturgerakkan Pasukan SMART untuk operasi mencari dan menyelamat di dalam dan luar Negara apabila perlu.
target_text: Managing and mobilizing the Special Malaysia Disaster Assistance and Rescue Team (SMART) for search and rescue operations locally and abroad as necessary.

source_text: Merancang dan menyelaras dasar serta mengawasi pelaksanaan latih amal dan simulasi pengurusan Bencana secara bersepadu dalam menghadapi dan mengurangkan Risiko Bencana.
target_text: Planning and coordinating policies and overseeing the implementation of integrated disaster management drills and simulations to face and reduce Disaster Risk.

source_text: Memantau dan memastikan pelaksanaan langkah-langkah Pengurangan Risiko Bencana yang dijalankan oleh Agensi Kerajaan bagi mencegah atau mengurangkan impak Bencana.
target_text: Monitoring and ensuring the implementation of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) measures carried out by Government Agencies to prevent or reduce disaster impacts.

source_text: Memastikan After Action Review (AAR) pengendalian Bencana diadakan selepas kejadian sesuatu Bencana.
target_text: Ensuring an After Action Review (AAR) of disaster handling is conducted after a disaster event occurs.

source_text: Menilai, menyelaras dan mengetuai misi bantuan kemanusiaan dan Tindak Balas Bencana ke luar Negara.
target_text: Evaluating, coordinating, and leading humanitarian assistance missions and Disaster Response abroad.

source_text: Pelan Strategik NADMA 2024-2028 merupakan dokumen rujukan utama warga kerja NADMA yang menggariskan arah tuju dan inisiatif strategik bagi memastikan NADMA kekal relevan.
target_text: The NADMA Strategic Plan 2024–2028 is the primary reference document for personnel, outlining strategic directions and initiatives to ensure the National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) remains relevant.

source_text: NADMA kekal sebagai peneraju utama pengurusan dan pengurangan risiko bencana negara selaras dengan mandat yang diberikan oleh Jemaah Menteri.
target_text: The National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) remains the lead agency for national disaster management and disaster risk reduction in accordance with the Cabinet mandate.

source_text: Pelan Strategik ini merupakan kesinambungan daripada Pelan Strategik NADMA 2019-2023 bagi menetapkan visi, misi dan rangka kerja bagi tempoh lima (5) tahun.
target_text: This Strategic Plan is a continuation of the 2019–2023 Strategic Plan to establish the vision, mission, and framework for a five-year period.

source_text: Pelan jangka panjang ini bertujuan memantapkan tadbir urus NADMA dalam pelaksanaan inisiatif pengurangan risiko bencana berdasarkan lapan teras strategik.
target_text: This long-term plan aims to strengthen NADMA’s governance in implementing disaster risk reduction initiatives based on eight strategic pillars.

source_text: Penyediaan pelan ini merujuk kepada Dasar Nasional DRR, Arahan MKN No. 20, Rancangan Malaysia Ke-12, AADMER, SFDRR, Sustainable Development Goals dan Teras Strategik Malaysia MADANI.
target_text: The preparation of this plan refers to the National DRR Policy, NSC Directive No. 20, the 12th Malaysia Plan, AADMER, SFDRR, Sustainable Development Goals, and the Malaysia MADANI Strategic Pillars.

source_text: Warga kerja NADMA akan dapat melaksanakan agenda organisasi secara terancang dan teratur serta memastikan matlamat jangka panjang organisasi dapat dicapai.
target_text: NADMA personnel will be able to execute the organizational agenda in a planned and orderly manner while ensuring long-term organizational goals are met.

source_text: Pemantauan dan penilaian perlu dilaksanakan bagi memastikan sasaran yang dirancang adalah tercapai dengan berkesan.
target_text: Monitoring and evaluation must be implemented to ensure that planned targets are achieved effectively.

source_text: Strategi yang termaktub telah dirangka dengan teliti agar dapat direalisasikan ke arah mewujudkan sebuah masyarakat yang berdaya tahan (resilient society).
target_text: The strategies outlined have been carefully formulated to be realized toward creating a resilient society.

source_text: Dalam melaksanakan kesemua teras strategik ini, sebanyak 20 strategi telah dirangka untuk dilaksanakan bermula tahun 2019.
target_text: In implementing all these strategic pillars, a total of 20 strategies were formulated for implementation starting in 2019.

source_text: Terdapat keperluan untuk Kerajaan menggubal dasar yang dapat memberikan tindakan komprehensif dan tadbir urus yang cekap dalam pengurusan risiko bencana (Disaster Risk Management, DRM).
target_text: There is a need for the Government to formulate a policy that provides comprehensive action and efficient governance in Disaster Risk Management (DRM).

source_text: Dasar Nasional Pengurangan Risiko Bencana (Dasar DRR) 2024-2030 diselarikan dengan Kerangka Kerja Sendai bagi Pengurangan Risiko Bencana 2015-2030.
target_text: The National Disaster Risk Reduction Policy (DRR Policy) 2024–2030 is aligned with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030.

source_text: Dasar ini menyediakan asas, panduan dan hala tuju untuk mengurangkan risiko bencana bagi menjamin keselamatan nyawa dan harta benda.
target_text: This policy provides the foundation, guidance, and direction to reduce disaster risks to ensure the safety of lives and property.

source_text: Pengurangan risiko dilakukan melalui pencegahan, mitigasi, kesiapsiagaan, tindak balas dan pemulihan semula.
target_text: Risk reduction is carried out through prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery.

source_text: Dasar DRR menggariskan empat (4) Prinsip: perkongsian tanggungjawab (shared responsibility); terangkum (inclusive); penyertaan (participation); dan penyetempatan (localization).
target_text: The DRR Policy outlines four (4) Principles: shared responsibility; inclusive; participation; and localization.

source_text: Teras Strategik pertama ialah Mengukuhkan Tadbir Urus.
target_text: The first Strategic Pillar is Strengthening Governance.

source_text: Teras Strategik kedua ialah Melabur dalam Pengurusan Risiko Bencana.
target_text: The second Strategic Pillar is Investing in Disaster Risk Management.

source_text: Teras Strategik ketiga ialah Menambahbaik Pemahaman Risiko.
target_text: The third Strategic Pillar is Improving Risk Understanding.

source_text: Teras Strategik keempat ialah Pembangunan Kapasiti dan Keterlibatan Komuniti.
target_text: The fourth Strategic Pillar is Capacity Building and Community Engagement.

source_text: Teras Strategik kelima ialah Meningkatkan Kesiapsiagaan untuk Tindak Balas Bencana yang Efektif dan Pemulihan Semula yang Lebih Baik.
target_text: The fifth Strategic Pillar is Enhancing Preparedness for Effective Disaster Response and Better Recovery.

source_text: Sasaran Utama merangkumi mengurangkan bilangan mereka yang terjejas bencana menjelang tahun 2030.
target_text: The Key Targets include reducing the number of people affected by disasters by the year 2030.

source_text: Dasar ini juga menyasarkan untuk mengurangkan kerugian langsung ekonomi akibat bencana.
target_text: This policy also aims to reduce direct economic losses resulting from disasters.

source_text: Pusat Kawalan Operasi Bencana (PKOB) telah diaktifkan di peringkat daerah.
target_text: The Disaster Operations Control Center (PKOB) has been activated at the district level.

source_text: Arahan No. 20 MKN menetapkan garis panduan pengurusan bencana negara.
target_text: NSC Directive No. 20 establishes the national disaster management guidelines.

source_text: Pasukan SMART dikerahkan ke lokasi tanah runtuh untuk operasi mencari dan menyelamat.
target_text: The SMART team is deployed to the landslide location for search and rescue operations.

source_text: Mangsa banjir telah dipindahkan ke Pusat Pemindahan Sementara (PPS) yang terdekat.
target_text: Flood victims have been evacuated to the nearest Temporary Evacuation Center (PPS).

source_text: Jawatankuasa Pengurusan Bencana Negeri (JPBN) sedang menilai impak kerosakan infrastruktur.
target_text: The State Disaster Management Committee (JPBN) is assessing the impact of infrastructure damage.

source_text: Bantuan Wang Ihsan (BWI) akan disalurkan kepada ketua isi rumah yang terjejas.
target_text: Compassionate Cash Assistance (BWI) will be distributed to affected heads of households.

source_text: Sistem Amaran Awal Bencana memberikan amaran awal kepada penduduk di zon bahaya.
target_text: The Disaster Early Warning System provides early warnings to residents in the hazard zone.

source_text: Latihan simulasi 'table-top' meningkatkan kesiapsiagaan agensi respons.
target_text: Table-top simulation exercises enhance the preparedness of response agencies.

source_text: Pihak berkuasa mengeluarkan perintah pemindahan mandatori bagi kawasan berisiko tinggi.
target_text: Authorities issued a mandatory evacuation order for high-risk areas.

source_text: Pengurangan Risiko Bencana (DRR) adalah teras utama dalam pelan strategik NADMA.
target_text: Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) is a core pillar in the NADMA strategic plan.

source_text: 国家灾难管理局 (NADMA) 已启动二级预警机制。
target_text: The National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) has activated the Level 2 alert mechanism.

source_text: 受灾群众已被疏散至附近的临时安置点 (PPS)。
target_text: Affected residents have been evacuated to the nearest Temporary Evacuation Center (PPS).

source_text: 特别搜救队 (SMART) 已被派往山体滑坡现场进行救援。
target_text: The Special Search and Rescue Team (SMART) has been dispatched to the landslide site for rescue operations.

source_text: 灾害行动控制中心 (PKOB) 负责协调各机构的响应工作。
target_text: The Disaster Operations Control Center (PKOB) is responsible for coordinating multi-agency response efforts.

source_text: 技术团队正在对关键基础设施进行快速损毁评估。
target_text: Technical teams are conducting a rapid damage assessment of critical infrastructure.

source_text: 政府将向受灾家庭发放慰问金 (BWI)。
target_text: The government will distribute Compassionate Cash Assistance (BWI) to affected families.

source_text: 早期预警系统在山洪暴发前触发了警报。
target_text: The early warning system triggered an alarm before the flash flood occurred.

source_text: 物流中心正在确保食品和卫生包的供应链畅通。
target_text: The logistics hub is ensuring the supply chain for food and hygiene kits remains open.

source_text: 州灾难管理委员会 (JPBN) 已宣布该地区进入紧急状态。
target_text: The State Disaster Management Committee (JPBN) has declared a state of emergency for the area.

source_text: 该减灾计划符合《仙台减灾框架》的要求。
target_text: This disaster reduction plan complies with the requirements of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction.
